meta: Sell your Alabama house as-is for cash. No repairs, no commissions, no realtor, and a closing date you choose. Hometown Home Buyers: 205-914-4215.
hero: Hometown Home Buyers is a family-owned, Springville-based company that buys houses across Alabama for cash, as-is. No repairs, no commissions or fees, and no realtor required. Review a no-obligation cash offer and choose your closing date.
intro: We buy houses throughout Alabama, from the Birmingham and St. Clair County area where we are based, to cities such as Huntsville, Montgomery, Mobile, Tuscaloosa, and Gadsden, and many communities in between. If you want to sell without listing, we buy the property as a principal and close with a local title company.

The process is the same wherever the house is in Alabama: you tell us about the property, we look at it, and we make a fair, no-obligation cash offer, often the same day. Closings usually happen in as little as 7-14 days, depending on title work, and you pick the move-out date. Leave the house exactly the way it is.
situations: Alabama families often inherit houses in a different city from where they live now. We buy those homes as-is so you do not have to travel back and forth to get one ready for the market.
If payments are behind, a cash sale can close as soon as title work allows, often in 7-14 days, with no obligation to accept the offer.
A shared Alabama property can be sold as-is, with a closing date you choose, instead of a long listing.
Whether you are moving across the state or leaving Alabama, you can time the closing to your move.
If a rental anywhere in Alabama is no longer worth managing, you can sell it as-is. A renovation is not required.
We buy houses as-is regardless of condition, including homes with fire, foundation, or other major damage.
Behind on payments or ready to be done
Request a no-obligation cash offer and decide once you have the number. If it is not a fit, just say no thanks.
faqs: Where in Alabama do you buy houses?

We are based in Springville and buy houses across Alabama and the Southeast, including Birmingham, St. Clair County, Trussville, Hoover, Gadsden, Tuscaloosa, Huntsville, Montgomery, Mobile, and other communities on our Areas We Serve list. Call 205-914-4215 and ask about your address.
Usually in as little as 7-14 days, depending on title work. If you need more time, you pick the date that works for you.
Do I have to make repairs or clean out the house?
No. We buy as-is. Take what you want and leave the rest. We'll handle it.
Are there any fees or commissions?
No. There are no agent commissions and no hidden fees, and in most cases we cover the normal closing costs.
How do you decide on my offer?
We look at your home's location, condition, needed repairs, and recent nearby sales. Then we give you a fair, no-obligation cash offer, often the same day.
Do I need a realtor to sell my Alabama house for cash?
No. We buy property as a principal, so no realtor is required. You may still wish to consult a licensed agent or attorney before you sell.
None. If our offer doesn't work for you, just say no thanks.
Will you buy a house in any condition?
Yes. We buy houses as-is regardless of condition, including homes that need major repairs.
